question: Calculate the gap statistic for K-means clustering with k values from 1 to 20, using 10 Monte Carlo reference datasets and random_state=42. For each k, compare the log within-cluster dispersion to that of uniform reference datasets drawn from the observed feature ranges. Identify the optimal k as the smallest k where gap(k) >= gap(k+1) - s(k+1) (where s(k+1) is the standard error) and report the gap values and standard errors for each k.
